column_explanations.title: Headline of the article.
column_explanations.text: Article body or best available descriptive text.
column_explanations.subject: Original subject/category from the source dataset.
column_explanations.label: Target label, FAKE or REAL.
column_explanations.dataset_source: Which raw dataset contributed the row.
column_explanations.source_group: A finer source or category grouping.
column_explanations.combined_text: Title and text joined for modeling.

selection_policy.classifier: Choose the model with the best validation macro F1, then weighted F1, then accuracy. Speed is shown but only used as a late tie-breaker.
selection_policy.topic_model: Choose the topic model with the highest quality score based on coherence and topic diversity. Training time is shown separately but is not the main criterion.
